Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 훈련 중 <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(이)가 설비를 부수고 말았다. 어떻게 할까?
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: During training, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ended up damaging the equipment. What should I do?
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: トレーニング中、<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>が設備を壊してしまった。どうしよう？
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 训练过程中<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>把设施弄坏了，该怎么办好呢？
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 訓練過程中<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>把設施弄壞了，該怎麼辦好呢？
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Pendant l'entraînement de <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>, les installations ont été détruites. Que devons-nous faire ?
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Während des Trainings hat <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> die Einrichtungen zerstört. Was sollen wir tun?
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Durante el entrenamiento, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> terminó destruyendo las instalaciones. ¿Qué debemos hacer?
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Durante o treinamento de <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>, as instalações foram destruídas. O que devemos fazer?
Data.UnitTalk_THA: ระหว่างการฝึกของ <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> สิ่งอำนวยความสะดวกถูกทำลาย เราควรทำอย่างไรดีคะ?
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Selama latihan, fasilitas dihancurkan oleh <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>. Apa yang harus kita lakukan?
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Trong lúc <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> huấn luyện, các trang thiết bị đã bị phá hủy. Phải làm sao đây?
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: प्रशिक्षण के दौरान <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने सुविधाओं को नष्ट कर दिया। अब क्या करें?

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ENG: Let's call it a day for today's training.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: 今日のトレーニングはここまでにしよう。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_CHN: 今天的训练就到此为止吧。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_TWN: 今天的訓練就到此為止吧。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_DEU: Beenden wir das heutige Training hier.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ESP: Terminemos el entrenamiento de hoy aquí.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_PRT: Vamos encerrar o treinamento de hoje por aqui.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: วันนี้พอแค่นี้ก่อนนะคะ
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_IND: Mari kita akhiri latihan hari ini sampai di sini.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Hãy kết thúc buổi huấn luyện hôm nay tại đây.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_HIN: आज का प्रशिक्षण यहीं समाप्त करते हैं।

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ENG: Let's keep going a bit more!
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_DEU: Machen wir noch ein bisschen weiter!
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: ไปต่ออีกหน่อยเถอะค่ะ!
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Hãy tập thêm một chút nữa!

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: 活力ポーションを渡す。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_FRA: A remis une potion de vitalité.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: มอบยาเพิ่มพลังให้
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Đã đưa một bình thuốc sinh lực.

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> decided to stop training and take a break.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>はトレーニングを中断し、休憩を取ることにした。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a décidé d'arrêter l'entraînement et de faire une pause.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> beschloss, das Training zu unterbrechen und eine Pause einzulegen.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> decidió detener el entrenamiento y tomar un descanso.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> decidiu parar o treinamento e fazer uma pausa.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ตัดสินใจหยุดการฝึกและพักผ่อน
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> memutuskan untuk menghentikan latihan dan beristirahat.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> đã quyết định dừng huấn luyện và nghỉ ngơi.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने प्रशिक्षण बंद करने और आराम करने का फैसला किया।

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 휴식하기로 했지만 <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(은)는 시설을 파손한 것이 마음에 걸리는 것 같다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Though she decided to rest, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> still seemed troubled by all the equipment she'd damaged.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 休憩することにしたものの、<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は施設を破壊してしまったことを気にしているようだ。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 虽然决定休息，但<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>似乎对破坏设施一事仍感到介意。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 雖然決定休息，但<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>似乎對破壞設施一事仍感到介意。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Même si <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a décidé de se reposer, il semble que la destruction des installations les tracasse.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Obwohl <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> beschlossen hat, sich auszuruhen, scheint es, als würde das Zerstören der Einrichtungen sie stören.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Aunque <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> decidió descansar, parece que destruir las instalaciones le está molestando.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Embora <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tenha decidido descansar, parece que destruir as instalações está incomodando.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: แม้ว่า <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> จะตัดสินใจพักผ่อน แต่ดูเหมือนว่าการทำลายสิ่งอำนวยความสะดวกยังคงรบกวนจิตใจพวกเขาอยู่
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Meskipun <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> memutuskan untuk beristirahat, sepertinya menghancurkan fasilitas mengganggu dia.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Dù <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> đã quyết định nghỉ ngơi, nhưng việc phá hủy các trang thiết bị dường như vẫn khiến họ bận tâm.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: भले ही <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने आराम करने का फैसला किया, लेकिन ऐसा लगता है कि सुविधाओं को नष्ट करना उन्हें परेशान कर रहा है।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Sparring with <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> proved more effective than regular training!
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>とトレーニングの代わりに手合わせを行い、成果を上げることができた！
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 与<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>改以对练代替训练，取得了成果！
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 與<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>改以對練代替訓練，取得了成果！
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a obtenu des résultats grâce à la pratique de combat plutôt que par l'entraînement !
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> erzielte Ergebnisse durch Sparring statt Training!
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: ¡<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> logró resultados en lugar de entrenar!
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> obteve resultados lutando em vez de treinar!
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ได้ผลลัพธ์จากการประลองแทนการฝึก!
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> mencapai hasil dengan berlatih tanding alih-alih berlatih!
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> đã đạt được kết quả bằng cách đấu tập thay vì huấn luyện!
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने प्रशिक्षण के बजाय द्वंद्वयुद्ध करके परिणाम प्राप्त किए!

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(은)는 다시 훈련에 도전했지만, 예비 설비까지 망가뜨리고 말았다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tried again, but even the spare equipment was destroyed this time.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は再びトレーニングに挑んだが、予備の設備まで壊してしまった。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>再次挑战训练，却连备用设施也一并弄坏了。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>再次挑戰訓練，卻連備用設施也一併弄壞了。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a de nouveau tenté l'entraînement, mais même les installations de secours ont été détruites.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> forderte das Training erneut heraus, aber selbst die Ersatzeinrichtungen wurden zerstört.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> volvió a desafiar el entrenamiento, pero terminó destruyendo incluso las instalaciones de respaldo.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> desafiou o treinamento novamente, mas até as instalações de reserva foram destruídas.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ท้าทายการฝึกอีกครั้ง แต่แม้แต่สิ่งอำนวยความสะดวกสำรองก็ถูกทำลาย
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> menantang latihan lagi, tetapi bahkan fasilitas cadangan pun hancur.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> đã thử thách huấn luyện lại, nhưng ngay cả các trang thiết bị dự phòng cũng bị phá hủy.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने फिर से प्रशिक्षण को चुनौती दी, लेकिन यहां तक कि बैकअप सुविधाएं भी नष्ट हो गईं।

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(은)는 선뜻 활력 포션을 마시고 훈련에 다시 임했다!
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Without hesitation, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> drank the Vitality Potion and resumed training!
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>はためらうことなく活力ポーションを飲み干し、再び訓練に打ち込んだ！
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>爽快地喝下活力药水，重新投入训练！
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>爽快地喝下活力藥水，重新投入訓練！
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a bu la potion de vitalité et s'est replongé dans l'entraînement !
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> trank den Vitalitätstrank und stürzte sich wieder ins Training!
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: ¡<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> bebió la poción de vitalidad y se lanzó de nuevo al entrenamiento!
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> bebeu uma poção de vitalidade e voltou ao treinamento!
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ดื่มยาเพิ่มพลังอย่างไม่ลังเลและกลับไปฝึกอีกครั้ง!
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> dengan sigap meminum ramuan vitalitas dan kembali berlatih!
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> đã uống thuốc sinh lực và lao vào huấn luyện trở lại!
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने जीवन शक्ति औषधि पी और फिर से प्रशिक्षण में कूद पड़े!
